title: Value Object

validation.research: Evans's original accessible DDD Reference, Value Objects on printed page 12, establishes meaningful attributes, functionality, conceptual absence of identity, immutability, and side-effect-free operations. Fowler supports property equality, aliasing, replacement, and contextual modeling. His DTO catalog distinguishes the transport role and historical naming overload. Microsoft supports component equality and distinguishes persistence keys from domain identity. Official Python sources support exact concrete-type/field equality, compatible hashing, shallow frozen-field behavior, immutable calendar dates, date arithmetic, and hash obligations. The nonempty half-open stay policy, example, and illustrations are original teaching material.
validation.python_examples: Both actual article blocks execute together and produce all five stated output lines exactly. Checks verify separate equal instances, both endpoints and concrete type in equality, unsupported comparisons, no implicit ordering, equal hashes for equal values, dictionary lookup and set behavior, frozen fields, immutable date components, unchanged aliases, replacement with new objects, signed and zero whole-day shifts, leap days and year boundaries, empty/reversed range rejection, rejection of timestamps/text/Boolean/fractional shifts, and overflow without state changes. The model imports only dataclasses and datetime and performs no I/O.

example_limits: Date-only in-memory values count calendar nights, not elapsed hours or time-zone-aware instants. Nonempty half-open stays are an explicit teaching policy, not a universal date-range rule. Frozen dataclasses emulate public-API immutability; immutable date fields avoid nested mutable state, but this is no defense against deliberate runtime bypass. The cache illustrates pure calculation lookup, not reservation identity or availability. No persistence, authorization, clock, allocation registry, booking coordination, transaction, or concurrent owner-update protection is implemented. Value equality requires neither interning nor a shared-instance cache.
publication: Local implementation only. No publishing, deployment, push, or pull request.
